entries.speaker: Security Guard
entries.en: Hm? I don't think I recognize you.[n]Are you a new hire?
entries.uk: Хм? Щось я тебе не впізнаю.[n]Ти новенький?

entries.speaker: Security Guard
entries.en: ...So? Do you need something?
Let's turn off those lasers.
I forgot the password.
Nice to meet you.

entries.speaker: Security Guard
entries.en: Oh, that's easy. Just enter 07734 into[n]the machine in the security office.
entries.uk: О, це просто. Введи 07734 на пульті[n]в кімнаті охорони.

entries.speaker: Security Guard
entries.en: Get it? You read the numbers a certain[n]way, and it's "hello." Easy to remember,[n]right?
entries.uk: Розумієш? Якщо глянути на цифри догори[n]дриґом, вийде «hello». Легко[n]запам'ятати, еге ж?

entries.speaker: Security Guard
entries.en: Oh, the password for the security room?[n]Just type in 07734.
entries.uk: А, пароль від кімнати охорони?[n]Просто введи 07734.

entries.speaker: Security Guard
entries.en: Get it? You read the numbers a certain[n]way, and it's "hello." Easy to remember,[n]right?
entries.uk: Розумієш? Якщо глянути на цифри догори[n]дриґом, вийде «hello». Легко[n]запам'ятати, еге ж?

entries.speaker: Security Guard
entries.en: Well, you're awfully polite. I like[n]that. Let me know if you need help[n]understanding something.
entries.uk: Ти диви, який чемний. Мені подобається.[n]Звертайся, якщо щось буде незрозуміло.

entries.speaker: Security Guard
entries.en: ...Wait, why do you want to turn off[n]the lasers?
I'm an intruder.
I'm stealing the Treasure.
I just wanted to try it...

entries.speaker: Security Guard
entries.en: I knew it!

entries.speaker: Security Guard
entries.en: What!? So YOU'RE the intruder!

entries.speaker: Security Guard
entries.en: Wow, you too? To be honest, I've[n]tried doing it myself.
entries.uk: Ого, ти теж? Чесно кажучи, я й сам[n]пробував.

entries.speaker: Security Guard
entries.en: Just don't tell Lord Madarame, okay?
entries.uk: Тільки не кажи лорду Мадараме, гаразд?

entries.en: What was the password?
Can we turn off the lasers?

entries.speaker: Security Guard
entries.en: Oh, the password for the security room?[n]Just type in 07734.
entries.uk: А, пароль від кімнати охорони?[n]Просто введи 07734.

entries.speaker: Security Guard
entries.en: Get it? You read the numbers a certain[n]way, and it's "hello." Easy to remember,[n]right?
entries.uk: Розумієш? Якщо глянути на цифри догори[n]дриґом, вийде «hello». Легко[n]запам'ятати, еге ж?

entries.speaker: Security Guard
entries.en: Oh, that's easy. Just enter 07734 into[n]the machine in the security office.
entries.uk: О, це просто. Введи 07734 на пульті[n]в кімнаті охорони.

entries.speaker: Security Guard
entries.en: Get it? You read the numbers a certain[n]way, and it's "hello." Easy to remember,[n]right?
entries.uk: Розумієш? Якщо глянути на цифри догори[n]дриґом, вийде «hello». Легко[n]запам'ятати, еге ж?

entries.speaker: Security Guard
entries.en: It looks like we've got some sort of[n]intruders. Three masked people and[n]one weird-looking critter.
entries.uk: Схоже, в нас тут якісь зловмисники.[n]Троє в масках і одна дивна звірюка.

entries.speaker: Security Guard
entries.en: But do they really think they can get[n]past our security? Hahahahaha!
entries.uk: Та невже вони думають, що проб'ються[n]крізь нашу охорону? Ха-ха-ха-ха!

entries.speaker: Voice
entries.en: Thank you for visiting.

entries.speaker: Voice
entries.en: Currently, we are holding an exhibition of[n]the works of the great artist Madarame.
entries.uk: Нині у нас триває виставка робіт[n]великого митця Мадараме.

entries.speaker: Voice
entries.en: Madarame can always be found on the[n]cutting edge of the Japanese art world.
entries.uk: Мадараме завжди перебуває на вістрі[n]японського мистецтва.

entries.speaker: Voice
entries.en: This exhibit attempts to express and[n]share the appeal of Madarame's works.
entries.uk: Ця виставка прагне виразити й[n]передати чар робіт Мадараме.

entries.speaker: Voice
entries.en: His unique ideas, unrestrained by[n]preconceived notions...

entries.speaker: Voice
entries.en: ...give rise to new possibilities in the[n]Nihonga art form.

entries.speaker: Voice
entries.en: Not only has he helped pioneer new[n]developments in the art world...
entries.uk: Він не лише прокладає нові шляхи[n]у світі мистецтва...

entries.speaker: Voice
entries.en: ...but he has also dedicated himself to[n]training the next generation of artists.
entries.uk: ...а й присвятив себе вихованню[n]нового покоління митців.

entries.speaker: Voice
entries.en: He is an irreplaceable figure in the[n]modern world of Japanese art.

entries.speaker: Voice
entries.en: The eyes of the world are on Madarame.[n]How will his next move change the art[n]world?
entries.uk: Очі всього світу прикуті до Мадараме.[n]Як його наступний крок змінить світ[n]мистецтва?

entries.speaker: Announcement
entries.en: This work, attentively painted with[n]delicate strokes...

entries.speaker: Announcement
entries.en: ...is noted for its use of deep, intricate[n]colors.

entries.speaker: Announcement
entries.en: The features of the model are captured[n]masterfully.

entries.speaker: Announcement
entries.en: It's almost as if they were right there[n]in front of you.
entries.uk: Здається, ніби вона стоїть просто[n]перед вами.

entries.speaker: Announcement
entries.en: Not only does it exude an imposing[n]presence...

entries.speaker: Announcement
entries.en: ...but it has a mysterious, unique allure...

entries.speaker: Announcement
entries.en: ...that draws in and captivates all who[n]look at it.
entries.uk: ...що притягує й полонить кожного,[n]хто на неї гляне.

entries.speaker: Announcement
entries.en: It has an everlasting appeal...

entries.speaker: Announcement
entries.en: ...that makes you feel like you could[n]gaze upon it forever.

entries.speaker: Announcement
entries.en: It would not be an overstatement to[n]call this painting "perfect."
